# Project Asset Provenance Record

The S2P-XInput-Lite maintainer confirms that the release artwork under
`image/` was drawn and produced for this project and does not use externally
sourced artwork:

Copyright (c) 2026 DuoDuo. These project assets are distributed under the
project's GNU General Public License v3.0.

- `icon.png` and `testicon.png` are generic pixel-art controller icons and do
  not contain a visible vendor logo.
- `S2P-XInput-Lite-600x340.png` and `S2P-XInput-Lite-banner.jpg` combine that
  artwork with the S2P-XInput-Lite project name and application imagery.
- `GUI.gif` and `test.gif` are recordings of the S2P-XInput-Lite applications.

The images under `manual/assets/annotated/` are screenshots and annotations
produced by the maintainer from the S2P-XInput-Lite user interface. Third-party
product names visible in the UI are used only to describe compatibility. The
assets do not include Nintendo or Microsoft artwork, character art, packaging,
or official logos.

Future contributors should update this file before adding externally sourced
artwork, fonts, screenshots, or other media, and must retain the applicable
permission and attribution with the new asset.
